'n## C:\Users\admin\Desktop\ALEJANDRA\Proyectos\Manda2DeliveryPlatform\Manda2.Mobile.UI\Pages\Auth\LoginPage.razor'n\''\'csharp'n@page "/auth/login"
@using System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations
@using Manda2.Contracts.Auth
@using Manda2.Mobile.Services.Auth
@using Manda2.Mobile.Services.Session

@inject IAuthService AuthService
@inject ISessionService SessionService
@inject NavigationManager Navigation

<div class="login-container">
    <div class="brand-header">
        <div class="brand-logo">??</div>
        <h1 class="brand-name">Manda<span class="brand-accent">2</span></h1>
        <p class="brand-tagline">Tu delivery de confianza</p>
    </div>

    <div class="form-card">
        <h2 class="form-title">Iniciar sesión</h2>

        @if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_errorMessage))
        {
            <div class="alert-error">?? @_errorMessage</div>
        }

        <EditForm Model="_model" OnValidSubmit="HandleLogin">
            <DataAnnotationsValidator />
            <ValidationSummary />

            <div class="form-group">
                <label class="form-label">Correo electrónico</label>
                <InputText class="form-input" @bind-Value="_model.Email" />
            </div>

            <div class="form-group">
                <label class="form-label">Contraseña</label>
                <div class="input-password-wrapper">
                    <InputText class="form-input"
                               type="@(_showPassword ? "text" : "password")"
                               @bind-Value="_model.Password" />
                    <button type="button" class="btn-toggle-password" @onclick="TogglePassword">
                        @(_showPassword ? "??" : "???")
                    </button>
                </div>
            </div>

            <button class="btn-primary" type="submit" disabled="@_isLoading">
                @if (_isLoading)
                {
                    <span>? Ingresando...</span>
                }
                else
                {
                    <span>Ingresar</span>
                }
            </button>
        </EditForm>

        <div class="form-divider">¿No tienes cuenta?</div>

        <button class="btn-secondary" @onclick='() => Navigation.NavigateTo("/Auth/register")'>
            Crear cuenta nueva
        </button>
    </div>
</div>

@code {
    private bool _isLoading = false;
    private bool _showPassword = false;
    private string _errorMessage = string.Empty;

    private readonly LoginModel _model = new();

    private class LoginModel
    {
        [Required]
        [EmailAddress]
        public string Email { get; set; } = string.Empty;

        [Required]
        public string Password { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    }

    private async Task HandleLogin()
    {
        _errorMessage = string.Empty;

        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_model.Email) || string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_model.Password))
        {
            _errorMessage = "Por favor completa todos los campos.";
            return;
        }

        _isLoading = true;

        try
        {
            var request = new LoginRequest
            {
                Email = _model.Email.Trim(),
                Password = _model.Password
            };

            var result = await AuthService.LoginAsync(request);

            if (result.Success)
            {
                await SessionService.SaveSessionAsync(result);

                var destination = result.Role switch
                {
                    "Customer" => "/customer/select-address?returnUrl=%2Fcustomer%2Fhome",
                    //"Customer" => "/test-map",
                    "Driver" => "/driver/home",
                    "Merchant" => "/merchant/home",
                    _ => "/auth/login"
                };

                Navigation.NavigateTo(destination, forceLoad: false);
            }
            else
            {
                _errorMessage = result.Message ?? "Credenciales incorrectas.";
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _errorMessage = $"Error de conexión: {ex.Message}";
        }
        finally
        {
            _isLoading = false;
        }
    }

    private void TogglePassword() => _showPassword = !_showPassword;
}

@using Manda2.Contracts.Auth
@using Manda2.Mobile.Services.Auth
@using Manda2.Mobile.Services.Session

@inject IAuthService AuthService
@inject ISessionService SessionService
@inject NavigationManager Navigation

<div class="profile-container">

    <!-- ENCABEZADO CON AVATAR -->
    <div class="profile-header">
        <div class="avatar-circle">@_initials</div>
        <div class="profile-info">
            <h2 class="profile-name">@(_session?.FullName ?? _session?.Email ?? "Usuario")</h2>
            <span class="profile-role-badge">@_session?.Role</span>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- DATOS DE CUENTA -->
    <div class="section-card">
        <h3 class="section-title">Mi cuenta</h3>

        <div class="info-row">
            <span class="info-icon">??</span>
            <div class="info-content">
                <span class="info-label">Correo</span>
                <span class="info-value">@(_session?.Email ?? "—")</span>
            </div>
        </div>

        <div class="info-row">
            <span class="info-icon">??</span>
            <div class="info-content">
                <span class="info-label">Rol</span>
                <span class="info-value">@(_session?.Role ?? "—")</span>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- SECCIÓN SESIÓN — LOGOUT AL FINAL -->
    <div class="section-card section-danger">
        <h3 class="section-title">Sesión</h3>

        @if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_logoutError))
        {
            <div class="alert-error">?? @_logoutError</div>
        }

        <button class="btn-logout"
                @onclick="HandleLogout"
                disabled="@_isLoggingOut">
            @(_isLoggingOut ? "? Cerrando sesión..." : "?? Cerrar sesión")
        </button>

        <p class="logout-hint">
            Al cerrar sesión tu token será invalidado en el servidor.
        </p>
    </div>

</div>

@code {
    private SessionData? _session = null;
    private string _initials = "?";
    private string _logoutError = string.Empty;
    private bool _isLoggingOut = false;

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        _session = await SessionService.GetSessionAsync();

        if (_session != null)
        {
            // Calcular iniciales para el avatar
            var name = _session.FullName;
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(name))
            {
                var parts = name.Split(' ', StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
                _initials = parts.Length >= 2
                    ? $"{parts[0][0]}{parts[1][0]}".ToUpper()
                    : name[..1].ToUpper();
            }
            else if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_session.Email))
            {
                _initials = _session.Email[..1].ToUpper();
            }
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Flujo de logout:
    /// 1. POST api/auth/logout ? invalida RefreshToken en la DB del servidor.
    /// 2. ClearSessionAsync   ? elimina datos de SecureStorage local.
    /// 3. Redirigir a /login.
    /// Si el servidor falla, igual se limpia la sesión local.
    /// </summary>
    private async Task HandleLogout()
    {
        _logoutError = string.Empty;
        _isLoggingOut = true;

        try
        {
            // Invalidar token en el servidor
            await AuthService.LogoutAsync();
        }
        catch
        {
            // Si el servidor no responde, continuamos con el logout local
        }
        finally
        {
            // ClearSessionAsync ya limpia SecureStorage
            // y además dispara OnSessionChanged(null)
            await SessionService.ClearSessionAsync();

            _isLoggingOut = false;

            // Ruta correcta
            Navigation.NavigateTo("/auth/login", forceLoad: false);
        }
    }
}

'n## C:\Users\admin\Desktop\ALEJANDRA\Proyectos\Manda2DeliveryPlatform\Manda2.Mobile.UI\Pages\Auth\Register.razor'n\''\'csharp'n@page "/auth/register"
@using Manda2.Contracts.Auth
@using Manda2.Mobile.Services.Auth

@inject IAuthService AuthService
@inject NavigationManager Navigation

<div class="register-container">

    <!-- ENCABEZADO -->
    <div class="page-header">
        <button class="btn-back" @onclick='() => Navigation.NavigateTo("/login")'>
            ? Volver
        </button>
        <span class="brand-logo-sm">??</span>
    </div>

    <div class="form-card">
        <h2 class="form-title">Crear cuenta</h2>
        <p class="form-subtitle">Únete a Manda2 y empieza a pedir</p>

        @if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_errorMessage))
        {
            <div class="alert-error">?? @_errorMessage</div>
        }

        @if (_registrationSuccess)
        {
            <div class="alert-success">
                ? ¡Cuenta creada exitosamente!
                <br />
                <button class="btn-link" @onclick='() => Navigation.NavigateTo("/login")'>
                    Ir al Login ?
                </button>
            </div>
        }
        else
        {
            <div class="form-group">
                <label class="form-label">Nombre</label>
                <input class="form-input" type="text" placeholder="Juan"
                       @bind="_firstName" @bind:event="oninput" />
            </div>

            <div class="form-group">
                <label class="form-label">Apellido</label>
                <input class="form-input" type="text" placeholder="Pérez"
                       @bind="_lastName" @bind:event="oninput" />
            </div>

            <div class="form-group">
                <label class="form-label">Correo electrónico</label>
                <input class="form-input" type="email" placeholder="tucorreo@ejemplo.com"
                       @bind="_email" @bind:event="oninput" />
            </div>

            <div class="form-group">
                <label class="form-label">Teléfono</label>
                <input class="form-input" type="tel" placeholder="+502 1234-5678"
                       @bind="_phone" @bind:event="oninput" />
            </div>

            <div class="form-group">
                <label class="form-label">Contraseña</label>
                <div class="input-password-wrapper">
                    <input class="form-input"
                           type="@(_showPassword ? "text" : "password")"
                           placeholder="Mínimo 8 caracteres"
                           @bind="_password" @bind:event="oninput" />
                    <button class="btn-toggle-password" @onclick="TogglePassword">
                        @(_showPassword ? "??" : "???")
                    </button>
                </div>
            </div>

            <div class="form-group">
                <label class="form-label">Confirmar contraseña</label>
                <input class="form-input" type="password" placeholder="Repite tu contraseña"
                       @bind="_confirmPassword" @bind:event="oninput" />
            </div>

            <button class="btn-primary" @onclick="HandleRegister" disabled="@_isLoading">
                @(_isLoading ? "? Creando cuenta..." : "Crear cuenta")
            </button>

            <div class="form-divider">¿Ya tienes cuenta?</div>

            <button class="btn-secondary" @onclick='() => Navigation.NavigateTo("/login")'>
                Iniciar sesión
            </button>
        }
    </div>
</div>

@code {
    private string _firstName = string.Empty;
    private string _lastName = string.Empty;
    private string _email = string.Empty;
    private string _phone = string.Empty;
    private string _password = string.Empty;
    private string _confirmPassword = string.Empty;
    private string _errorMessage = string.Empty;
    private bool _isLoading = false;
    private bool _showPassword = false;
    private bool _registrationSuccess = false;

    /// <summary>
    /// Flujo de registro:
    /// 1. Validación client-side.
    /// 2. POST api/auth/register via IAuthService.
    /// 3. Mostrar confirmación o error.
    /// </summary>
    private async Task HandleRegister()
    {
        _errorMessage = string.Empty;

        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_firstName) ||
            string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_email) ||
            string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_password))
        {
            _errorMessage = "Nombre, correo y contraseña son obligatorios.";
            return;
        }

        if (_password != _confirmPassword)
        {
            _errorMessage = "Las contraseñas no coinciden.";
            return;
        }

        if (_password.Length < 8)
        {
            _errorMessage = "La contraseña debe tener al menos 8 caracteres.";
            return;
        }

        _isLoading = true;

        try
        {
            var request = new RegisterRequest
            {
                Email = _email.Trim(),
                Password = _password,
                Role = "Customer",          // Fijo desde la app MAUI
                FirstName = _firstName.Trim(),
                LastName = _lastName.Trim(),
                Phone = _phone.Trim()
            };

            var result = await AuthService.RegisterAsync(request);

            if (result.Success)
                _registrationSuccess = true;
            else
                _errorMessage = result.Message ?? "No se pudo crear la cuenta.";
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _errorMessage = $"Error de conexión: {ex.Message}";
        }
        finally
        {
            _isLoading = false;
        }
    }

    private void TogglePassword() => _showPassword = !_showPassword;
}

'n## C:\Users\admin\Desktop\ALEJANDRA\Proyectos\Manda2DeliveryPlatform\Manda2.Mobile.UI\Pages\CheckOut\CheckoutPage.razor'n\''\'csharp'n@page "/checkout/{OrderGroupId:int}"
@using Manda2.Mobile.Services.Session
@using Manda2.Mobile.Services.ShippingAddress
@using Manda2.Mobile.Services.CheckOut
@using Manda2.Contracts.CheckOut
@using Manda2.Contracts.Customer

@inject ISessionService Session
@inject IShippingAddressApiService ShippingService
@inject IPaymentMethodApiService PaymentService
@inject ICheckoutApiService CheckoutService
@inject NavigationManager Navigation

<div class="checkout-page">

    <!-- HEADER -->
    <div class="checkout-header">
        <button class="btn-back" @onclick='() => Navigation.NavigateTo("/customer/cart")'>
            ?
        </button>
        <h2 class="checkout-title">Finalizar Pedido</h2>
    </div>

    @if (_isLoading)
    {
        <div class="checkout-loading">
            <div class="spinner-border text-primary" role="status"></div>
            <p>Calculando envío...</p>
        </div>
    }
    else
    {
        <!-- SECCIÓN 1: DIRECCIÓN DE ENTREGA -->
        <div class="checkout-section">
            <div class="section-label">?? Dirección de entrega</div>

            @if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_selectedAddressText))
            {
                <div class="address-display">
                    <span class="address-text">@_selectedAddressText</span>
                    <button class="btn-change" @onclick="ChangeAddress">
                        Cambiar
                    </button>
                </div>
            }
            else
            {
                <div class="address-empty">
                    <span>No hay dirección seleccionada.</span>
                    <button class="btn-change" @onclick="ChangeAddress">
                        Seleccionar
                    </button>
                </div>
            }
        </div>

        <!-- SECCIÓN 2: RESUMEN DE TOTALES (solo si logística confirmada) -->
        @if (_logisticsConfirmed && _summary != null)
        {
            <div class="checkout-section checkout-summary">
                <div class="section-label">?? Resumen</div>

                <div class="summary-row">
                    <span>Subtotal</span>
                    <span>Q @_summary.SubTotal.ToString("F2")</span>
                </div>
                <div class="summary-row">
                    <span>Delivery</span>
                    <span>Q @_summary.DeliveryFee.ToString("F2")</span>
                </div>
                <div class="summary-row">
                    <span>Tarifa de servicio</span>
                    <span>Q @_summary.ServiceFee.ToString("F2")</span>
                </div>
                <div class="summary-row summary-total">
                    <span>TOTAL</span>
                    <span>Q @_summary.TotalAmount.ToString("F2")</span>
                </div>
            </div>

            <!-- SECCIÓN 3: MÉTODO DE PAGO -->
            <div class="checkout-section">
                <div class="section-label">?? Método de pago</div>

                <div class="payment-methods">
                    @foreach (var pm in _paymentMethods)
                    {
                        <button class="payment-btn @(_selectedPaymentMethod?.Id == pm.Id ? "active" : "")"
                                @onclick="() => SelectPaymentMethod(pm)">
                            @GetPaymentIcon(pm.Name) @pm.Name
                        </button>
                    }
                </div>

                @if (_selectedPaymentMethod?.RequiresReference == true)
                {
                    <div class="reference-field">
                        <label>Número de referencia</label>
                        <input type="text"
                               class="form-input"
                               placeholder="Ej: 123456789"
                               @bind="_referenceNumber" />
                    </div>
                }
            </div>

            <!-- BOTÓN PAGAR -->
            @if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_errorMessage))
            {
                <div class="checkout-error">?? @_errorMessage</div>
            }

            <button class="btn-pay @(!_canPay ? "disabled" : "")"
                    @onclick="ProcessOrder"
                    disabled="@(!_canPay)">
                @if (_isProcessing)
                {
                    <span>Procesando...</span>
                }
                else
                {
                    <span>PAGAR  Q @_summary.TotalAmount.ToString("F2")</span>
                }
            </button>
        }
        else if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_selectedAddressText))
        {
            <!-- Dirección seleccionada pero logística aún calculando -->
            <div class="checkout-calculating">
                <div class="spinner-border spinner-border-sm text-primary" role="status"></div>
                <span>Calculando costo de envío...</span>
            </div>
        }
        else
        {
            <div class="checkout-hint">
                Selecciona una dirección para calcular el envío.
            </div>
        }
    }
</div>


@code {
    // -- Parámetro de ruta ------------------------------------------------------
    [Parameter] public int OrderGroupId { get; set; }

    // -- Estado interno ---------------------------------------------------------
    private bool _isLoading = true;
    private bool _isProcessing = false;
    private bool _logisticsConfirmed = false;

    private List<PaymentMethodDto> _paymentMethods = new();
    private PaymentMethodDto? _selectedPaymentMethod;
    private ConfirmOrderGroupResult? _summary;

    private string _selectedAddressText = string.Empty;
    private int? _selectedAddressId;
    private string _referenceNumber = string.Empty;
    private string _errorMessage = string.Empty;

    // -- Computed ---------------------------------------------------------------
    private bool _canPay =>
        _logisticsConfirmed
        && _selectedPaymentMethod != null
        && (_selectedPaymentMethod.RequiresReference == false
            || !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_referenceNumber));

    // -- Lifecycle --------------------------------------------------------------

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        try
        {
            // 1. Cargar métodos de pago
            _paymentMethods = await PaymentService.GetActivePaymentMethodsAsync();

            // 2. Priorizar dirección de sesión sobre IsDefault
            if (Session.SelectedShippingAddressId.HasValue)
            {
                _selectedAddressId = Session.SelectedShippingAddressId.Value;
                _selectedAddressText = Session.SelectedAddressText ?? string.Empty;
            }
            else
            {
                // Fallback: cargar direcciones y tomar la default
                var addresses = await ShippingService.GetMyShippingAddressesAsync();
                var def = addresses.FirstOrDefault(a => a.IsDefault)
                       ?? addresses.FirstOrDefault();

                if (def != null)
                {
                    _selectedAddressId = def.Id;
                    _selectedAddressText = $"{def.Alias} - {def.AddressLine1}, {def.City}";

                    // Persistir en sesión para consistencia
                    Session.SelectedShippingAddressId = def.Id;
                    Session.SelectedAddressText = _selectedAddressText;
                }
            }

            // 3. Si hay dirección, calcular logística inmediatamente
            if (_selectedAddressId.HasValue)
                await RecalculateLogisticsAsync();
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _errorMessage = $"Error al cargar el checkout: {ex.Message}";
        }
        finally
        {
            _isLoading = false;
        }
    }

    protected override async Task OnParametersSetAsync()
    {
        // Se ejecuta al regresar desde SelectDeliveryAddressPage (NavigationManager cambia params).
        // Si la sesión tiene una dirección diferente a la actual, recalcular.
        if (!_isLoading
            && Session.SelectedShippingAddressId.HasValue
            && Session.SelectedShippingAddressId != _selectedAddressId)
        {
            _selectedAddressId = Session.SelectedShippingAddressId.Value;
            _selectedAddressText = Session.SelectedAddressText ?? string.Empty;
            _logisticsConfirmed = false;
            _summary = null;

            await RecalculateLogisticsAsync();
        }
    }

    // -- Métodos ----------------------------------------------------------------

    /// <summary>
    /// Navega a SelectDeliveryAddressPage con returnUrl apuntando de vuelta a este checkout.
    /// Al regresar, OnParametersSetAsync detecta el cambio y recalcula.
    /// </summary>
    private void ChangeAddress()
    {
        var returnUrl = Uri.EscapeDataString($"/checkout/{OrderGroupId}");
        Navigation.NavigateTo($"/customer/select-address?returnUrl={returnUrl}");
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Llama a POST /api/checkout/confirm-order-group.
    /// Transiciona Draft ? CapacityValidated y obtiene totales reales.
    /// </summary>
    private async Task RecalculateLogisticsAsync()
    {
        if (_selectedAddressId == null) return;

        _isLoading = true;
        _errorMessage = string.Empty;

        try
        {
            var request = new ConfirmOrderGroupRequest
            {
                OrderGroupId = OrderGroupId,
                ShippingAddressId = _selectedAddressId.Value
            };

            _summary = await CheckoutService.ConfirmOrderGroupLogisticsAsync(request);
            _logisticsConfirmed = true;

            // Actualizar texto de dirección con el confirmado por el backend
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_summary.DeliveryAddressText))
            {
                _selectedAddressText = _summary.DeliveryAddressText;
                Session.SelectedAddressText = _selectedAddressText;
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _logisticsConfirmed = false;
            _errorMessage = $"No se pudo calcular el envío: {ex.Message}";
        }
        finally
        {
            _isLoading = false;
        }
    }

    private void SelectPaymentMethod(PaymentMethodDto method)
    {
        _selectedPaymentMethod = method;
        _referenceNumber = string.Empty; // limpiar referencia al cambiar método
        _errorMessage = string.Empty;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Paso final: POST /api/checkout.
    /// Transiciona CapacityValidated ? PendingPayment / PaymentConfirmed.
    /// </summary>
    private async Task ProcessOrder()
    {
        if (!_canPay || _summary == null) return;

        _isProcessing = true;
        _errorMessage = string.Empty;

        try
        {
            var request = new ConfirmCheckoutRequest
            {
                OrderGroupId = OrderGroupId,
                PaymentMethodId = _selectedPaymentMethod!.Id,
                Reference = _referenceNumber
            };

            var result = await CheckoutService.FinalizeCheckoutAsync(request);

            if (result != null)
            {
                // Limpiar dirección de sesión (el pedido ya fue confirmado)
                Session.SelectedShippingAddressId = null;
                Session.SelectedAddressText = null;

                Navigation.NavigateTo($"/order-confirmation/{OrderGroupId}");
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _errorMessage = $"Error al procesar el pago: {ex.Message}";
        }
        finally
        {
            _isProcessing = false;
        }
    }

    private static string GetPaymentIcon(string name) => name.ToLower() switch
    {
        "efectivo" or "cash" => "??",
        "tarjeta" or "card" => "??",
        "transferencia" or "transfer" => "??",
        "nota de crédito" or "credit_note" => "??",
        _ => "??"
    };
}

'n## C:\Users\admin\Desktop\ALEJANDRA\Proyectos\Manda2DeliveryPlatform\Manda2.Mobile.UI\Pages\Customer\CreateShippingAddressPage.razor'n\''\'csharp'n@page "/customer/create-address"
@using Manda2.Contracts.Customer
@using Manda2.Mobile.Services.ShippingAddress
@using Manda2.Mobile.Services.Session
@using Manda2.Mobile.UI.Components.Map
@inject IShippingAddressApiService AddressService
@inject ISessionService Session
@inject NavigationManager Nav

<div style="height:250px;width:100%">
    <DeliveryMapComponent Latitude="_request.Latitude"
                          Longitude="_request.Longitude"
                          OnLocationChanged="UpdateCoords" />
</div>

<div class="create-address-page">
    <div class="page-header">
        <button class="btn-back" @onclick="GoBack">?</button>
        <h2>Nueva dirección</h2>
    </div>

    <div class="form-container">
        <div class="form-group">
            <label>Ciudad / zona</label>
            <select @bind="_request.City" class="form-select">
                @foreach (var country in _countries)
                {
                    <option value="@country">@country</option>
                }
            </select>
        </div>

        <div class="form-group">
            <label>Alias de la dirección</label>
            <div class="alias-options">
                @foreach (var alias in _aliasOptions)
                {
                    <button type="button"
                            class="alias-btn @(_request.Alias == alias ? "active" : "")"
                            @onclick="() => _request.Alias = alias">
                        @GetAliasIcon(alias) @alias
                    </button>
                }
            </div>
        </div>

        <div class="form-group">
            <label>Dirección <span class="required">*</span></label>
            <input type="text"
                   class="form-input"
                   placeholder="Ej: Colonia Los Robles, Calle Principal"
                   @bind="_request.AddressLine1" />
        </div>

        <div class="form-group">
            <label>No. Apartamento / Casa (opcional)</label>
            <input type="text"
                   class="form-input"
                   placeholder="Ej: Apto 4B, Casa 12"
                   @bind="_request.ApartmentNumber" />
        </div>

        <div class="form-group">
            <label>Referencia (opcional)</label>
            <input type="text"
                   class="form-input"
                   placeholder="Ej: Frente al parque central"
                   @bind="_request.AddressLine2" />
        </div>

        <div class="form-group">
            <label>Instrucciones para el repartidor (opcional)</label>
            <textarea class="form-textarea"
                      rows="2"
                      placeholder="Ej: Tocar el timbre 2 veces, portón azul"
                      @bind="_request.DeliveryNotes"></textarea>
        </div>

        <div class="form-group">
            <label>Teléfono de contacto (opcional)</label>
            <div class="phone-row">
                <select class="form-select phone-code" @bind="_request.PhoneCountryCode">
                    <option value="+502">???? +502</option>
                    <option value="+505">???? +505</option>
                    <option value="+503">???? +503</option>
                    <option value="+504">???? +504</option>
                    <option value="+506">???? +506</option>
                    <option value="+507">???? +507</option>
                    <option value="+52">???? +52</option>
                    <option value="+1">???? +1</option>
                </select>

                <input type="tel"
                       class="form-input phone-number"
                       placeholder="Número de teléfono"
                       @bind="_request.ContactPhone" />
            </div>
        </div>

        <div class="form-group checkbox-group">
            <label class="checkbox-label">
                <input type="checkbox" @bind="_request.IsDefault" />
                Establecer como dirección principal
            </label>
        </div>


        @if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_error))
        {
            <p class="error-msg">@_error</p>
        }

        <button class="btn-save" @onclick="SaveAddress" disabled="@_saving">
            @(_saving ? "Guardando..." : "Guardar dirección")
        </button>
    </div>
</div>

@code
{
    [Parameter, SupplyParameterFromQuery]
    public string? ReturnUrl { get; set; }

    private CreateShippingAddressRequest _request = new()
    {
        Alias = "Casa",
        City = "Nicaragua",
        PhoneCountryCode = "+505",
        IsDefault = false,
        Latitude = 13.093765924724813,
        Longitude = -86.0006766303026,
        AddressLine1 = string.Empty
    };

    private bool _saving;
    private string _error = string.Empty;

    private readonly List<string> _aliasOptions = new() { "Casa", "Trabajo", "Gym", "Otro" };

    private readonly List<string> _countries = new()
    {
        "Guatemala", "Nicaragua", "El Salvador", "Honduras", "Costa Rica", "Panamá", "México"
    };

    /// <summary>
    /// Recibe desde el componente de mapa la posición seleccionada.
    /// </summary>
    private Task UpdateCoords((double Latitude, double Longitude) coords)
    {
        _request.Latitude = coords.Latitude;
        _request.Longitude = coords.Longitude;
        return InvokeAsync(StateHasChanged);
    }

    private async Task SaveAddress()
    {
        _error = string.Empty;

        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_request.AddressLine1))
        {
            _error = "La dirección es obligatoria.";
            return;
        }

        if (_request.Latitude == 0 && _request.Longitude == 0)
        {
            _error = "Por favor ajusta el pin en el mapa.";
            return;
        }

        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_request.City))
        {
            _error = "La ciudad es obligatoria.";
            return;
        }

        _saving = true;

        try
        {
            var newId = await AddressService.CreateShippingAddressAsync(_request);

            Session.SelectedShippingAddressId = newId;
            Session.SelectedAddressText = $"{_request.Alias} - {_request.AddressLine1}, {_request.City}";

            Nav.NavigateTo(ReturnUrl ?? "/customer/select-address");
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _error = $"No se pudo guardar la dirección: {ex.Message}";
        }
        finally
        {
            _saving = false;
        }
    }

    private void GoBack() => Nav.NavigateTo(ReturnUrl ?? "/customer/select-address");

    private static string GetAliasIcon(string alias) => alias.ToLower() switch
    {
        "casa" => "??",
        "trabajo" => "??",
        "gym" => "???",
        _ => "??"
    };
}

@using Manda2.Mobile.Services.Cart
@using Manda2.Mobile.Services.Catalog
@using Manda2.Contracts.Cart
@using Manda2.Mobile.Services.Orders

@inject ICartService CartService
@inject IOrderGroupApiService OrderGroupApiService
@inject NavigationManager Nav
@implements IDisposable

<div class="cc-page">

    @if (!CartService.Merchants.Any())
    {
        <!-- -- Estado vacío -- -->
        <div class="cc-empty">
            <i class="bi bi-cart-x"></i>
            <h3>Tu carrito está vacío</h3>
            <p>Agrega productos desde tus comercios favoritos.</p>
            <button class="btn-primary" @onclick='() => Nav.NavigateTo("/customer/home")'>
                Explorar comercios
            </button>
        </div>
    }
    else
    {
        <!-- -- Header -- -->
        <div class="cc-header">
            <button class="cc-back" @onclick='() => Nav.NavigateTo("/customer/home")'>
                <i class="bi bi-arrow-left"></i>
            </button>
            <div>
                <h2 class="cc-title">Tu pedido</h2>
                <span class="cc-subtitle">
                    @CartService.Merchants.Count comercio(s) · @CartService.TotalItemCount item(s)
                </span>
            </div>
        </div>

        <!-- -- Bloques por comercio -- -->
        @foreach (var merchant in CartService.Merchants)
        {
            <div class="cc-merchant-block">

                <!-- Header del comercio -->
                <div class="cc-merchant-header">
                    @if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(merchant.LogoBase64))
                    {
                        <img src="@merchant.LogoBase64"
                             class="cc-merchant-logo"
                             alt="@merchant.MerchantName" />
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        <div class="cc-merchant-logo-placeholder">
                            <i class="bi bi-shop"></i>
                        </div>
                    }
                    <span class="cc-merchant-name">@merchant.MerchantName</span>
                    <button class="cc-remove-merchant"
                            @onclick="() => RemoveMerchant(merchant.MerchantId)"
                            title="Quitar comercio">
                        <i class="bi bi-x-circle"></i>
                    </button>
                </div>

                <!-- Items del comercio -->
                @foreach (var item in merchant.Items)
                {
                    <div class="cc-item">

                        <!-- Imagen -->
                        @if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(item.ImageUrl))
                        {
                            <img src="@item.ImageBase64"
                                 class="cc-item-img"
                                 alt="@item.Name" />
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            <div class="cc-item-img-placeholder">???</div>
                        }

                        <!-- Info -->
                        <div class="cc-item-info">
                            <span class="cc-item-name">@item.Name</span>
                            @if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(item.SpecialInstructions))
                            {
                                <span class="cc-item-note">?? @item.SpecialInstructions</span>
                            }
                            <span class="cc-item-price">Q @item.UnitPrice.ToString("F2") c/u</span>
                        </div>

                        <!-- Controles de cantidad -->
                        <div class="cc-qty">
                            <button class="cc-qty-btn"
                                    @onclick="() => DecreaseItem(merchant.MerchantId, item)">
                                -
                            </button>
                            <span class="cc-qty-val">@item.Quantity</span>
                            <button class="cc-qty-btn"
                                    @onclick="() => IncreaseItem(merchant.MerchantId, item)">
                                +
                            </button>
                        </div>

                        <!-- Total de línea -->
                        <span class="cc-item-total">
                            Q @((item.UnitPrice * item.Quantity).ToString("F2"))
                        </span>

                    </div>
                }

                <!-- Subtotal del comercio -->
                <div class="cc-merchant-subtotal">
                    <span>Subtotal @merchant.MerchantName</span>
                    <span>Q @merchant.SubTotal.ToString("F2")</span>
                </div>

            </div>
        }

        <!-- -- Resumen de totales -- -->
        <div class="cc-totals">
            <div class="cc-total-row">
                <span>Subtotal productos</span>
                <span>Q @CartService.GrandTotal.ToString("F2")</span>
            </div>
            <div class="cc-total-row cc-total-note">
                <span>Envío y cargos de servicio</span>
                <span>Se calculan al confirmar</span>
            </div>
        </div>

        <!-- -- Error -- -->
        @if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_errorMessage))
        {
            <div class="cc-error">
                <i class="bi bi-exclamation-triangle-fill"></i>
                @_errorMessage
            </div>
        }

        <!-- -- CTA -- -->
        <div class="cc-cta">
            <button class="btn-checkout"
                    @onclick="ConfirmOrderAsync"
                    disabled="@_isBusy">
                @if (_isBusy)
                {
                    <span class="spinner-border spinner-border-sm me-2" role="status"></span>
                    <span>Procesando...</span>
                }
                else
                {
                    <span>Confirmar pedido ?</span>
                }
            </button>
        </div>
    }
</div>

@code{
    private bool _isBusy = false;
    private string? _errorMessage;

    // --- LIFECYCLE ----------------------------------------------------
    protected override void OnInitialized()
    {
        CartService.OnCartChanged += OnCartStateChanged;
    }

    public void Dispose()
    {
        CartService.OnCartChanged -= OnCartStateChanged;
    }

    private void OnCartStateChanged()
    {
        InvokeAsync(StateHasChanged);
    }

    // --- OPERACIONES DE CARRITO ---------------------------------------

    private void IncreaseItem(int merchantId, CartStateItem item)
    {
        // Agregar 1 unidad más del mismo producto
        CartService.AddItem(
            merchantId: merchantId,
            merchantName: CartService.GetMerchantCart(merchantId)?.MerchantName ?? string.Empty,
            logoBase64: CartService.GetMerchantCart(merchantId)?.LogoBase64,
            item: new CartStateItem
            {
                ProductId = item.ProductId,
                MerchantProductId = item.MerchantProductId,
                Name = item.Name,
                ImageUrl = item.ImageUrl,
                UnitPrice = item.UnitPrice,
                Quantity = 1,
                SpecialInstructions = item.SpecialInstructions
            });
    }

    private void DecreaseItem(int merchantId, CartStateItem item)
    {
        CartService.RemoveOneItem(merchantId, item.ProductId);
    }

    private void RemoveMerchant(int merchantId)
    {
        CartService.RemoveMerchant(merchantId);
    }

    // --- CONFIRMAR PEDIDO ---------------------------------------------
    /// <summary>
    /// Construye el payload para CreateOrderGroup y llama al API.
    /// En esta fase (MVP) la dirección de entrega es placeholder
    /// hasta que se implemente el selector de dirección en Checkout.
    /// </summary>
    private async Task ConfirmOrderAsync()
    {
        if (_isBusy) return;
        _isBusy = true;
        _errorMessage = null;

        try
        {
            var result = await OrderGroupApiService.CreateOrderGroupAsync(CartService.Merchants);

            if (result.IsSuccess)
            {
                // Limpiar carrito en memoria
                CartService.Clear();

                // Navegar a Checkout con el OrderGroupId recién creado
                Nav.NavigateTo($"/checkout/{result.OrderGroupId}");
            }
            else
            {
                _errorMessage = result.ErrorMessage ?? "No se pudo crear el pedido.";
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _errorMessage = $"Error al confirmar: {ex.Message}";
        }
        finally
        {
            _isBusy = false;
        }
    }
}

@using Manda2.Mobile.Services.Catalog
@using Manda2.Contracts.Catalog
@using Manda2.Mobile.UI.Components.Catalog
@inject ICatalogService CatalogService
@inject NavigationManager NavigationManager

<div class="customer-home-wrapper">

   @*  {{!-- -- HERO -- --}} *@
    <div class="home-hero">
        <div class="hero-address">
            <i class="bi bi-geo-alt-fill"></i>
            <span class="hero-address-text">Mi ubicación</span>
            <i class="bi bi-chevron-down ms-1 small"></i>
        </div>
        <div class="hero-search">
            <i class="bi bi-search search-icon"></i>
            <input type="text"
                   class="search-input"
                   placeholder="Buscar comercios o productos..."
                   value="@_searchTerm"
                   @oninput="OnSearchInput" />
        </div>
    </div>

    @if (_isLoading)
    {
        <div class="loading-container">
            <div class="spinner-border text-primary" role="status">
                <span class="visually-hidden">Cargando...</span>
            </div>
        </div>
    }
    else
    {
        @* { { !-- -- CAROUSEL 1: Categorías(cfg.MerchantCategories) -- --} } *@
        @if (_categories.Any())
        {
            <CategoryCarousel Categories="_categories" />
        }

        @* { { !-- -- CAROUSEL 2: Comercios destacados(core.Merchants abiertos) -- --} } *@
        @if (_openMerchants.Any())
        {
            <MerchantCarousel Title="Abiertos ahora"
                              Merchants="_openMerchants" />
        }

       @*  { { !-- -- SECCIÓN: Todos los comercios con filtro -- --} } *@
        <div class="section-header">
            <span class="section-title">Explorar</span>
        </div>

        @if (_filteredMerchants.Any())
        {
            <div class="merchants-grid">
                @foreach (var merchant in _filteredMerchants)
                {
                    <MerchantCard Merchant="merchant"
                                  OnClick="() => NavigateToMerchant(merchant.MerchantId)" />
                }
            </div>
        }
        else
        {
            <div class="empty-state">
                <i class="bi bi-shop-window"></i>
                <p>No hay comercios disponibles.</p>
                <button class="btn btn-outline-primary btn-sm" @onclick="LoadDataAsync">
                    Reintentar
                </button>
            </div>
        }
    }

</div>


@code {
    private List<MerchantCategoryDto> _categories = new();
    private List<MerchantSummaryDto> _merchants = new();
    private List<MerchantSummaryDto> _openMerchants = new();
    private List<MerchantSummaryDto> _filteredMerchants = new();
    private bool _isLoading = true;
    private string _searchTerm = string.Empty;

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        await LoadDataAsync();
    }

    private async Task LoadDataAsync()
    {
        try
        {
            _isLoading = true;

            // Carga paralela: categorías + comercios
            var categoriesTask = CatalogService.GetMerchantCategoriesAsync();
            var merchantsTask = CatalogService.GetOpenMerchantsAsync();

            await Task.WhenAll(categoriesTask, merchantsTask);

            _categories = categoriesTask.Result;
            _merchants = merchantsTask.Result;
            _openMerchants = _merchants.Where(m => m.IsOpen).Take(10).ToList();
            _filteredMerchants = _merchants.ToList();
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Console.WriteLine($"[CustomerHome] Error: {ex.Message}");
        }
        finally
        {
            _isLoading = false;
        }
    }

    private void OnSearchInput(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        _searchTerm = e.Value?.ToString() ?? string.Empty;
        ApplySearch();
    }

    private void ApplySearch()
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_searchTerm))
        {
            _filteredMerchants = _merchants.ToList();
            return;
        }

        _filteredMerchants = _merchants
            .Where(m =>
                m.Name.Contains(_searchTerm, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                (m.CategoryName?.Contains(_searchTerm, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ?? false))
            .ToList();
    }

    private void NavigateToMerchant(int merchantId)
    {
        NavigationManager.NavigateTo($"/merchant/{merchantId}");
    }
}

'n## C:\Users\admin\Desktop\ALEJANDRA\Proyectos\Manda2DeliveryPlatform\Manda2.Mobile.UI\Pages\Customer\MerchantDetail.razor'n\''\'csharp'n@page "/merchant/{MerchantId:int}"
@using Manda2.Mobile.Services.Catalog
@using Manda2.Mobile.Services.Cart
@using Manda2.Contracts.Catalog
@using Manda2.Mobile.UI.Components.Catalog
@inject ICatalogService CatalogService
@inject ICartService CartService
@inject NavigationManager Nav
@inject IHttpClientFactory HttpClientFactory

@implements IDisposable

<div class="md-page">

    @if (_loading)
    {
        <div class="md-loading">
            <div class="spinner-border text-primary" role="status">
                <span class="visually-hidden">Cargando...</span>
            </div>
        </div>
    }
    else if (_merchant == null)
    {
        <div class="md-not-found">
            <i class="bi bi-shop-window"></i>
            <p>Comercio no encontrado.</p>
            <button class="btn btn-outline-primary btn-sm"
                    @onclick='() => Nav.NavigateTo("/customer/home")'>
                Volver al inicio
            </button>
        </div>
    }
    else
    {
        @* -- BANNER DE ADVERTENCIA TEMPRANA (Idea A) -- *@
        @if (_showEarlyWarning)
        {
            <div class="md-banner md-banner--warning">
                <i class="bi bi-exclamation-triangle-fill"></i>
                <span>
                    Estás agregando tu último comercio permitido
                    (@CartService.Merchants.Count de @CartService.MerchantLimit).
                    Finaliza este pedido para agregar más.
                </span>
            </div>
        }
        else if (_showLimitBanner)
        {
            <div class="md-banner md-banner--danger">
                <i class="bi bi-slash-circle-fill"></i>
                <span>
                    Límite de comercios alcanzado
                    (@CartService.MerchantLimit/@CartService.MerchantLimit).
                    Finaliza tu pedido actual o quita un comercio.
                </span>
            </div>
        }

        @* -- HERO -- *@
        <div class="md-hero">
            <div class="md-hero__bg"
                 style="background-image: url('@(_logoBase64 ?? "https://placehold.co/800x300?text=Comercio")');">
            </div>
            <div class="md-hero__overlay"></div>

            <button class="md-hero__back" @onclick='() => Nav.NavigateTo("/customer/home")'>
                <i class="bi bi-arrow-left"></i>
            </button>

            <div class="md-hero__logo-wrapper">
                <img src="@(_logoBase64 ?? "https://placehold.co/100x100?text=Logo")"
                     class="md-hero__logo"
                     alt="@_merchant.Name" />
            </div>
        </div>

        @* -- INFO DEL COMERCIO -- *@
        <div class="md-info">
            <div class="md-info__header">
                <div>
                    <h2 class="md-info__name">@_merchant.Name</h2>
                    <p class="md-info__category">@_merchant.CategoryName</p>
                    @if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_merchant.AddressText))
                    {
                        <p class="md-info__address">
                            <i class="bi bi-geo-alt"></i> @_merchant.AddressText
                        </p>
                    }
                </div>
                <span class="@(_merchant.IsOpen ? "md-badge--open" : "md-badge--closed")">
                    @(_merchant.IsOpen ? "Abierto" : "Cerrado")
                </span>
            </div>

            @* Stats — rating y ETA son placeholders visuales hasta que exista contrato *@
            <div class="md-info__stats">
                <div class="md-stat">
                    <i class="bi bi-star-fill text-warning"></i>
                    <span>4.5</span>
                    @* TODO: pendiente de contrato — no es dato de negocio *@
                </div>
                <div class="md-stat-divider"></div>
                <div class="md-stat">
                    <i class="bi bi-clock text-muted"></i>
                    <span>25-35 min</span>
                    @* TODO: pendiente de contrato *@
                </div>
                <div class="md-stat-divider"></div>
                <div class="md-stat">
                    <i class="bi bi-bicycle text-success"></i>
                    <span class="text-success fw-bold">Envío Gratis</span>
                    @* TODO: pendiente de contrato *@
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>

        @* -- PRODUCTOS -- *@
        <div class="md-products">

            @if (_loadingProducts)
            {
                <div class="md-products__loading">
                    <div class="spinner-border spinner-border-sm text-primary" role="status"></div>
                    <p>Cargando menú...</p>
                </div>
            }
            else if (!_groupedProducts.Any())
            {
                <div class="md-products__empty">
                    <i class="bi bi-bag-x"></i>
                    <p>No hay productos disponibles.</p>
                </div>
            }
            else
            {
                @foreach (var group in _groupedProducts)
                {
                    <div class="md-category-section">
                        <h3 class="md-category-title">@group.Key</h3>

                        @foreach (var product in group.Value)
                        {
                            <MerchantProductCard Product="product"
                                                 CurrentQuantity="CartService.GetItemQuantity(MerchantId, product.ProductId)"
                                                 CurrentNote="@GetCurrentNote(product.ProductId)"
                                                 IsAddDisabled="@IsAddDisabledFor()"
                                                 OnAdd="HandleAddProduct"
                                                 OnRemove="HandleRemoveProduct"
                                                 OnNoteChanged="HandleNoteChanged" />
                        }
                    </div>
                }
            }
        </div>

        @if (_showLimitToast)
        {
            <div class="md-toast md-toast--limit">
                <i class="bi bi-slash-circle-fill"></i>
                Límite de comercios alcanzado. Finaliza tu pedido actual.
            </div>
        }

        @* -- CART BAR (Idea D) -- *@
        <MerchantCartBar CartService="CartService"
                         MerchantIsInCart="CartService.HasMerchant(MerchantId)"
                         ShowLimitWarning="CartService.IsAtMerchantLimit && !CartService.HasMerchant(MerchantId)" />
    }
</div>

@code {
    [Parameter]
    public int MerchantId { get; set; }

    // -- Estado ------------------------------------------------------------
    private MerchantSummaryDto? _merchant;
    private Dictionary<string, List<MerchantProductDto>> _groupedProducts = new();
    private bool _loading = true;
    private bool _loadingProducts = false;
    private string? _logoBase64;

    // -- Banners de límite -------------------------------------------------

    /// <summary>
    /// True cuando el carrito está en el penúltimo slot
    /// Y este comercio NO está en el carrito todavía.
    /// Idea A: advertencia temprana.
    /// </summary>
    private bool _showEarlyWarning =>
        !CartService.HasMerchant(MerchantId) &&
        CartService.Merchants.Count == CartService.MerchantLimit - 1 &&
        CartService.MerchantLimit > 1;

    /// <summary>
    /// True cuando el carrito ya alcanzó el límite
    /// Y este comercio NO está en el carrito.
    /// Idea A: banner rojo bloqueante.
    /// </summary>
    private bool _showLimitBanner =>
        CartService.IsAtMerchantLimit &&
        !CartService.HasMerchant(MerchantId);

    // -- Lifecycle ---------------------------------------------------------

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        CartService.OnCartChanged += OnCartStateChanged;
        await LoadMerchantAsync();
    }

    protected override async Task OnParametersSetAsync()
    {
        // Si navegaron a otro merchant sin destruir el componente
        if (_merchant?.MerchantId != MerchantId)
        {
            _merchant = null;
            _groupedProducts = new();
            _logoBase64 = null;
            await LoadMerchantAsync();
        }
    }

    public void Dispose()
    {
        CartService.OnCartChanged -= OnCartStateChanged;
    }

    private void OnCartStateChanged()
    {
        InvokeAsync(StateHasChanged);
    }

    // -- Carga de datos ----------------------------------------------------

    private async Task LoadMerchantAsync()
    {
        try
        {
            _loading = true;
            StateHasChanged();

            // Cargar lista de merchants para obtener el summary del comercio actual
            // (reutiliza el endpoint existente — no se inventa endpoint nuevo)
            var merchants = await CatalogService.GetMerchantsByCategoryAsync(null);
            _merchant = merchants.FirstOrDefault(m => m.MerchantId == MerchantId);

            if (_merchant != null)
            {
                // Cargar logo en paralelo con productos
                var logoTask = LoadLogoAsync(_merchant.LogoUrl);
                var productsTask = LoadProductsAsync();
                await Task.WhenAll(logoTask, productsTask);
                _logoBase64 = logoTask.Result;
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Console.WriteLine($"[MerchantDetail] Error cargando comercio {MerchantId}: {ex.Message}");
        }
        finally
        {
            _loading = false;
        }
    }

    private async Task LoadProductsAsync()
    {
        try
        {
            _loadingProducts = true;
            var products = await CatalogService.GetMerchantProductsAsync(MerchantId);

            // Agrupar por CategoryName para el menú por secciones
            _groupedProducts = products
                .GroupBy(p => p.CategoryName ?? "General")
                .ToDictionary(g => g.Key, g => g.ToList());
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Console.WriteLine($"[MerchantDetail] Error cargando productos: {ex.Message}");
        }
        finally
        {
            _loadingProducts = false;
        }
    }

    private async Task<string?> LoadLogoAsync(string? url)
    {
        // url ya llega absoluta desde CatalogService.FormatImageUrl
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(url)) return null;

        try
        {
            // Reutiliza el cliente registrado — no crea HttpClient nuevo
            var client = HttpClientFactory.CreateClient("ImageClient");
            var bytes = await client.GetByteArrayAsync(url);

            // Detectar tipo MIME básico por extensión
            var mime = url.EndsWith(".png", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ? "image/png"
                     : url.EndsWith(".webp", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ? "image/webp"
                     : "image/jpeg";

            return $"data:{mime};base64,{Convert.ToBase64String(bytes)}";
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Console.WriteLine($"[MerchantDetail] Error cargando logo: {ex.Message}");
            return null;
        }
    }

    // -- Lógica de carrito -------------------------------------------------

    /// <summary>
    /// True si el botón "Agregar" debe estar deshabilitado para este comercio.
    /// Se deshabilita cuando el carrito está en el límite Y este comercio no está en él.
    /// </summary>
    private bool IsAddDisabledFor()
        => CartService.IsAtMerchantLimit && !CartService.HasMerchant(MerchantId);
    private bool _showLimitToast = false;

    private async Task HandleAddProduct(MerchantProductDto product)
    {
        // Descargar imagen del producto como Base64 (mismo patrón que LoadLogoAsync)
        var imageBase64 = await LoadLogoAsync(product.ImageUrl);

        var item = new CartStateItem
        {
            ProductId = product.ProductId,
            MerchantProductId = product.MerchantProductId,
            Name = product.Name,
            ImageUrl = product.ImageUrl,      // reservado para futuro
            ImageBase64 = imageBase64,            // ? para display en CartPage
            UnitPrice = product.SalePrice,
            Quantity = 1,
            SpecialInstructions = null
        };

        var result = CartService.AddItem(
            merchantId: MerchantId,
            merchantName: _merchant?.Name ?? string.Empty,
            logoBase64: _logoBase64,
            item: item);

        if (result == AddToCartResult.MerchantLimitReached)
        {
            _showLimitToast = true;
            InvokeAsync(StateHasChanged);

            _ = Task.Delay(3000).ContinueWith(_ =>
            {
                _showLimitToast = false;
                InvokeAsync(StateHasChanged);
            });
        }
    }

    private void HandleRemoveProduct(MerchantProductDto product)
    {
        CartService.RemoveOneItem(MerchantId, product.ProductId);
    }

    private void HandleNoteChanged((MerchantProductDto Product, string? Note) args)
    {
        CartService.UpdateItemNote(MerchantId, args.Product.ProductId, args.Note);
    }

    private string? GetCurrentNote(int productId)
    {
        return CartService
            .GetMerchantCart(MerchantId)
            ?.Items.FirstOrDefault(i => i.ProductId == productId)
            ?.SpecialInstructions;
    }
}

@using Manda2.Contracts.Customer
@using Manda2.Mobile.Services.ShippingAddress
@using Manda2.Mobile.Services.Session
@inject IShippingAddressApiService AddressService
@inject ISessionService Session
@inject NavigationManager Nav

<div class="address-page">
    <div class="address-header">
        <h2>¿A dónde entregamos?</h2>
        <p class="subtitle">Selecciona o agrega una dirección</p>
    </div>

    @if (_loading)
    {
        <div class="loading-container">
            <div class="spinner"></div>
            <p>Cargando direcciones...</p>
        </div>
    }
    else
    {
        @if (_addresses.Any())
        {
            <div class="address-list">
                @foreach (var addr in _addresses)
                {
                    <div class="address-card @(addr.Id == _selectedId ? "selected" : "")"
                         @onclick="() => SelectAddress(addr)">
                        <div class="address-icon">
                            <span class="icon">@GetAliasIcon(addr.Alias)</span>
                        </div>
                        <div class="address-info">
                            <span class="alias">@addr.Alias</span>
                            @if (addr.IsDefault)
                            {
                                <span class="badge-default">Principal</span>
                            }
                            <p class="address-line">@addr.AddressLine1</p>
                            @if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(addr.ApartmentNumber))
                            {
                                <p class="apartment">#@addr.ApartmentNumber</p>
                            }
                            @if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(addr.DeliveryNotes))
                            {
                                <p class="notes">?? @addr.DeliveryNotes</p>
                            }
                            <p class="city">@addr.City</p>
                        </div>
                        @if (addr.Id == _selectedId)
                        {
                            <div class="check-icon">?</div>
                        }
                    </div>
                }
            </div>
        }
        else
        {
            <div class="empty-state">
                <span class="empty-icon">??</span>
                <p>Aún no tienes direcciones guardadas.</p>
            </div>
        }

        <button class="btn-add-address" @onclick="GoToCreate">
            + Agregar nueva dirección
        </button>

        @if (_selectedId.HasValue)
        {
            <button class="btn-confirm" @onclick="Confirm">
                Confirmar dirección
            </button>
        }
    }

    @if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_error))
    {
        <p class="error-msg">@_error</p>
    }
</div>
@code
{
    [Parameter]
    [SupplyParameterFromQuery]
    public string? ReturnUrl { get; set; }

    private List<ShippingAddressDto> _addresses = new();
    private int? _selectedId;
    private bool _loading = true;
    private string _error = string.Empty;

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        try
        {
            _addresses = await AddressService.GetMyShippingAddressesAsync();

            if (Session.SelectedShippingAddressId.HasValue)
            {
                _selectedId = Session.SelectedShippingAddressId.Value;
            }
            else
            {
                _selectedId = _addresses.FirstOrDefault(a => a.IsDefault)?.Id
                              ?? _addresses.FirstOrDefault()?.Id;
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _error = $"No se pudieron cargar las direcciones: {ex.Message}";
        }
        finally
        {
            _loading = false;
        }
    }

    private void SelectAddress(ShippingAddressDto address)
    {
        _selectedId = address.Id;
    }

    private void GoToCreate()
    {
        var returnUrl = Uri.EscapeDataString(ReturnUrl ?? "/customer/home");
        Nav.NavigateTo($"/customer/create-address?returnUrl={returnUrl}");
    }

    private static string GetAliasIcon(string alias) => alias.ToLower() switch
    {
        "casa" => "??",
        "trabajo" => "??",
        "gym" => "???",
        _ => "??"
    };

        private void Confirm()
        {
            if (!_selectedId.HasValue)
                return;

            var selected = _addresses.First(x => x.Id == _selectedId.Value);

            Session.SelectedShippingAddressId = selected.Id;
            Session.SelectedAddressText = $"{selected.Alias} - {selected.AddressLine1}, {selected.City}";

            Nav.NavigateTo(ReturnUrl ?? "/customer/home");
        }
    
        

    }

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        var session = await SessionService.GetSessionAsync();

        {

        };

        Navigation.NavigateTo(destination);
    }
}

'n## C:\Users\admin\Desktop\ALEJANDRA\Proyectos\Manda2DeliveryPlatform\Manda2.Mobile.UI\Pages\TestMapPage2.razor'n\''\'csharp'n<h3>TestMapPage2</h3>

\''\'
'n## C:\Users\admin\Desktop\ALEJANDRA\Proyectos\Manda2DeliveryPlatform\Manda2.Mobile.UI\wwwroot\js\deliveryMap.js'n\''\'csharp'n// PROPÓSITO: Gestión del mapa Azure Maps para DeliveryMapComponent.razor.
//            Reemplaza completamente la implementación anterior con Leaflet.
//
// FUNCIONES EXPORTADAS:
//   initDeliveryMap(elementId, lat, lon, clientId, dotNetRef)
//   setMapCenter(elementId, lat, lon)
//   destroyMap(elementId)
//   tryGetDeviceLocation(timeoutMs)
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

const _mapInstances = {};   // { elementId: { map, marker, datasource } }

// -- Carga dinámica del SDK de Azure Maps --------------------------------------
function loadAzureMapsSDK() {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        if (window.atlas) { resolve(); return; }

        // CSS
        const link = document.createElement('link');
        link.rel = 'stylesheet';
        link.href = 'https://atlas.microsoft.com/sdk/javascript/mapcontrol/3/atlas.min.css';
        document.head.appendChild(link);

        // JS
        const script = document.createElement('script');
        script.src = 'https://atlas.microsoft.com/sdk/javascript/mapcontrol/3/atlas.min.js';
        script.onload = () => resolve();
        script.onerror = () => reject(new Error('[DeliveryMap] No se pudo cargar Azure Maps SDK.'));
        document.head.appendChild(script);
    });
}

// -- Inicializa el mapa Azure Maps ---------------------------------------------
export async function initDeliveryMap(elementId, lat, lon, clientId, dotNetRef) {
    try {
        await loadAzureMapsSDK();
    } catch (e) {
        console.error(e.message);
        return;
    }

    // Destruir instancia previa si existe
    if (_mapInstances[elementId]) {
        try { _mapInstances[elementId].map.dispose(); } catch { }
        delete _mapInstances[elementId];
    }

    // Crear mapa con autenticación por Client ID (AAD Managed Identity)
    const map = new atlas.Map(elementId, {
        center: [lon, lat],   // Azure Maps: [longitude, latitude]
        zoom: 15,
        language: 'es-419',
        view: 'Auto',
        authOptions: {
            authType: 'subscriptionKey',
            subscriptionKey: clientId   // En modo profesional, clientId = subscriptionKey del frontend
        },
        style: 'road'
    });

    // Esperar a que el mapa esté listo
    map.events.add('ready', function () {

        // DataSource para el marcador
        const datasource = new atlas.source.DataSource();
        map.sources.add(datasource);

        // Marcador en posición inicial
        const point = new atlas.data.Feature(new atlas.data.Point([lon, lat]));
        datasource.add(point);

        // Capa de símbolo (marcador visual)
        const symbolLayer = new atlas.layer.SymbolLayer(datasource, null, {
            iconOptions: {
                image: 'pin-red',
                anchor: 'bottom',
                allowOverlap: true
            }
        });
        map.layers.add(symbolLayer);

        // Evento: click en el mapa ? mover marcador
        map.events.add('click', function (e) {
            if (!e.position) return;
            const [clickLon, clickLat] = e.position;
            _moveMarker(elementId, clickLat, clickLon);
            dotNetRef.invokeMethodAsync('OnMapMoved', clickLat, clickLon);
        });

        // Guardar instancia
        _mapInstances[elementId] = { map, datasource, point };
    });
}

// -- Mueve el marcador y centra el mapa ----------------------------------------
export function setMapCenter(elementId, lat, lon) {
    const instance = _mapInstances[elementId];
    if (!instance) {
        console.warn(`[DeliveryMap] setMapCenter: no existe instancia para (${elementId})`);
        return;
    }

    instance.map.setCamera({
        center: [lon, lat],
        zoom: 15,
        type: 'ease',
        duration: 500
    });

    _moveMarker(elementId, lat, lon);
}

// -- Mueve el marcador en el datasource ---------------------------------------
function _moveMarker(elementId, lat, lon) {
    const instance = _mapInstances[elementId];
    if (!instance) return;

    instance.datasource.clear();
    const newPoint = new atlas.data.Feature(new atlas.data.Point([lon, lat]));
    instance.datasource.add(newPoint);
    instance.point = newPoint;
}

// -- Destruye el mapa y libera recursos ---------------------------------------
export function destroyMap(elementId) {
    const instance = _mapInstances[elementId];
    if (!instance) return;

    try { instance.map.dispose(); } catch (e) {
        console.warn(`[DeliveryMap] Error al destruir mapa (${elementId}):`, e);
    }

    delete _mapInstances[elementId];
}

// -- Obtiene ubicación del dispositivo vía browser Geolocation API -------------
export async function tryGetDeviceLocation(timeoutMs = 8000) {
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
        try {

 *

// Creates a Point object with the given `x` and `y` coordinates. If optional `round` is set to true, rounds the `x` and `y` values.

// @alternative
// @factory L.point(coords: Number[])
// Expects an array of the form `[x, y]` instead.

// @alternative
// @factory L.point(coords: Object)
// Expects a plain object of the form `{x: Number, y: Number}` instead.

	if (x instanceof Point) {
		return x;
	}
	if (isArray(x)) {
		return new Point(x[0], x[1]);
	}
	if (x === undefined || x === null) {
		return x;
	}
	if (typeof x === 'object' && 'x' in x && 'y' in x) {
		return new Point(x.x, x.y);
	}
	return new Point(x, y, round);

 *
 * ```

	       e.detail ? e.detail / -32765 * 60 : // Legacy Moz pages

	try {
		while (related && (related !== el)) {
			related = related.parentNode;
		}
	} catch (err) {
		return false;
	}
	return (related !== el);

  __proto__: null,
  on: on,
  off: off,
  stopPropagation: stopPropagation,
  disableScrollPropagation: disableScrollPropagation,
  disableClickPropagation: disableClickPropagation,
  preventDefault: preventDefault,
  stop: stop,
  getPropagationPath: getPropagationPath,
  getMousePosition: getMousePosition,
  getWheelDelta: getWheelDelta,

/*
 * @class PosAnimation
 * @aka L.PosAnimation
 * @inherits Evented
 * Used internally for panning animations, utilizing CSS3 Transitions for modern browsers and a timer fallback for IE6-9.
 *
 * @example
 * ```js
 * var myPositionMarker = L.marker([48.864716, 2.294694]).addTo(map);
 *
 * myPositionMarker.on("click", function() {
 * 	var pos = map.latLngToLayerPoint(myPositionMarker.getLatLng());
 * 	pos.y -= 25;
 * 	var fx = new L.PosAnimation();
 *
 * 	fx.once('end',function() {
 * 		pos.y += 25;
 * 		fx.run(myPositionMarker._icon, pos, 0.8);
 * 	});
 *
 * 	fx.run(myPositionMarker._icon, pos, 0.3);
 * });
 *
 * ```
 *
 * @constructor L.PosAnimation()
 * Creates a `PosAnimation` object.
 *
 */

var PosAnimation = Evented.extend({

	// @method run(el: HTMLElement, newPos: Point, duration?: Number, easeLinearity?: Number)
	// Run an animation of a given element to a new position, optionally setting
	// duration in seconds (`0.25` by default) and easing linearity factor (3rd
	// argument of the [cubic bezier curve](https://cubic-bezier.com/#0,0,.5,1),
	// `0.5` by default).
	run: function (el, newPos, duration, easeLinearity) {
		this.stop();

		this._el = el;
		this._inProgress = true;
		this._duration = duration || 0.25;
		this._easeOutPower = 1 / Math.max(easeLinearity || 0.5, 0.2);

		this._startPos = getPosition(el);
		this._offset = newPos.subtract(this._startPos);
		this._startTime = +new Date();

		// @event start: Event
		// Fired when the animation starts
		this.fire('start');

		this._animate();
	},

	// @method stop()
	// Stops the animation (if currently running).
	stop: function () {
		if (!this._inProgress) { return; }

		this._step(true);
		this._complete();
	},

	_animate: function () {
		// animation loop
		this._animId = requestAnimFrame(this._animate, this);
		this._step();
	},

	_step: function (round) {
		var elapsed = (+new Date()) - this._startTime,
		    duration = this._duration * 1000;

		if (elapsed < duration) {
			this._runFrame(this._easeOut(elapsed / duration), round);
		} else {
			this._runFrame(1);
			this._complete();
		}
	},

	_runFrame: function (progress, round) {
		var pos = this._startPos.add(this._offset.multiplyBy(progress));
		if (round) {
			pos._round();
		}
		setPosition(this._el, pos);

		// @event step: Event
		// Fired continuously during the animation.
		this.fire('step');
	},

	_complete: function () {
		cancelAnimFrame(this._animId);

		this._inProgress = false;
		// @event end: Event
		// Fired when the animation ends.
		this.fire('end');
	},

	_easeOut: function (t) {
		return 1 - Math.pow(1 - t, this._easeOutPower);
	}
});

/*
 * @class Map
 * @aka L.Map
 * @inherits Evented
 *
 * The central class of the API â€” it is used to create a map on a page and manipulate it.
 *
 * @example
 *
 * ```js
 * // initialize the map on the "map" div with a given center and zoom

 * 	center: [51.505, -0.09],
 * 	zoom: 13
 * });
 * ```

var Map = Evented.extend({

	options: {

		    paddingBR = toPoint(options.paddingBottomRight || options.padding || [0, 0]),

		    pixelPoint = this.project(latlng),

			var offset = paddedBounds.extend(pixelPoint).getSize().subtract(paddedSize);
			pixelCenter.x += centerOffset.x < 0 ? -offset.x : offset.x;
			pixelCenter.y += centerOffset.y < 0 ? -offset.y : offset.y;

	// call it after you've changed the map size dynamically, also animating
	// pan by default. If `options.pan` is `false`, panning will not occur.
	// If `options.debounceMoveend` is `true`, it will delay `moveend` event so
	// that it doesn't happen often even if the method is called many
	// times in a row.

	// @alternative
	// @method invalidateSize(animate: Boolean): this

	// call it after you've changed the map size dynamically, also animating
	// pan by default.
	invalidateSize: function (options) {
		if (!this._loaded) { return this; }

			animate: false,
			pan: true

		this._sizeChanged = true;
		this._lastCenter = null;

		var newSize = this.getSize(),
		    oldCenter = oldSize.divideBy(2).round(),
		    newCenter = newSize.divideBy(2).round(),
		    offset = oldCenter.subtract(newCenter);

		if (!offset.x && !offset.y) { return this; }

		if (options.animate && options.pan) {
			this.panBy(offset);

		} else {
			if (options.pan) {

			}

			this.fire('move');

			if (options.debounceMoveend) {
				clearTimeout(this._sizeTimer);

		if (isNaN(this.options.radius)) { throw new Error('Circle radius cannot be NaN'); }

		// @section
		// @aka Circle options
		// @option radius: Number; Radius of the circle, in meters.
		this._mRadius = this.options.radius;
	},

	// @method setRadius(radius: Number): this
	// Sets the radius of a circle. Units are in meters.
	setRadius: function (radius) {
		this._mRadius = radius;
		return this.redraw();
	},

	// @method getRadius(): Number
	// Returns the current radius of a circle. Units are in meters.
	getRadius: function () {
		return this._mRadius;
	},

	// @method getBounds(): LatLngBounds
	// Returns the `LatLngBounds` of the path.
	getBounds: function () {
		var half = [this._radius, this._radiusY || this._radius];

		return new LatLngBounds(
			this._map.layerPointToLatLng(this._point.subtract(half)),
			this._map.layerPointToLatLng(this._point.add(half)));
	},

	setStyle: Path.prototype.setStyle,

	_project: function () {

		var lng = this._latlng.lng,
		    lat = this._latlng.lat,
		    map = this._map,
		    crs = map.options.crs;

		if (crs.distance === Earth.distance) {
			var d = Math.PI / 180,
			    latR = (this._mRadius / Earth.R) / d,
			    top = map.project([lat + latR, lng]),
			    bottom = map.project([lat - latR, lng]),
			    p = top.add(bottom).divideBy(2),
			    lat2 = map.unproject(p).lat,
			    lngR = Math.acos((Math.cos(latR * d) - Math.sin(lat * d) * Math.sin(lat2 * d)) /
			            (Math.cos(lat * d) * Math.cos(lat2 * d))) / d;

			if (isNaN(lngR) || lngR === 0) {

			this._point = p.subtract(map.getPixelOrigin());

			var latlng2 = crs.unproject(crs.project(this._latlng).subtract([this._mRadius, 0]));

			this._point = map.latLngToLayerPoint(this._latlng);
			this._radius = this._point.x - map.latLngToLayerPoint(latlng2).x;
		}

		this._updateBounds();
	}
});

// @factory L.circle(latlng: LatLng, options?: Circle options)
// Instantiates a circle object given a geographical point, and an options object
// which contains the circle radius.
// @alternative
// @factory L.circle(latlng: LatLng, radius: Number, options?: Circle options)
// Obsolete way of instantiating a circle, for compatibility with 0.7.x code.
// Do not use in new applications or plugins.
function circle(latlng, options, legacyOptions) {
	return new Circle(latlng, options, legacyOptions);
}

/*
 * @class Polyline
 * @aka L.Polyline
 * @inherits Path
 *
 * A class for drawing polyline overlays on a map. Extends `Path`.
 *
 * @example
 *
 * ```js
 * // create a red polyline from an array of LatLng points
 * var latlngs = [
 * 	[45.51, -122.68],
 * 	[37.77, -122.43],
 * 	[34.04, -118.2]
 * ];
 *
 * var polyline = L.polyline(latlngs, {color: 'red'}).addTo(map);
 *
 * // zoom the map to the polyline
 * map.fitBounds(polyline.getBounds());
 * ```
 *
 * You can also pass a multi-dimensional array to represent a `MultiPolyline` shape:
 *
 * ```js
 * // create a red polyline from an array of arrays of LatLng points
 * var latlngs = [
 * 	[[45.51, -122.68],
 * 	 [37.77, -122.43],
 * 	 [34.04, -118.2]],
 * 	[[40.78, -73.91],
 * 	 [41.83, -87.62],
 * 	 [32.76, -96.72]]
 * ];
 * ```
 */


var Polyline = Path.extend({

	// @section
	// @aka Polyline options
	options: {
		// @option smoothFactor: Number = 1.0
		// How much to simplify the polyline on each zoom level. More means
		// better performance and smoother look, and less means more accurate representation.
		smoothFactor: 1.0,

		// @option noClip: Boolean = false
		// Disable polyline clipping.
		noClip: false
	},

	initialize: function (latlngs, options) {
		setOptions(this, options);
		this._setLatLngs(latlngs);
	},

	// @method getLatLngs(): LatLng[]
	// Returns an array of the points in the path, or nested arrays of points in case of multi-polyline.
	getLatLngs: function () {
		return this._latlngs;
	},

	// @method setLatLngs(latlngs: LatLng[]): this
	// Replaces all the points in the polyline with the given array of geographical points.
	setLatLngs: function (latlngs) {
		this._setLatLngs(latlngs);
		return this.redraw();
	},

	// @method isEmpty(): Boolean
	// Returns `true` if the Polyline has no LatLngs.
